question: Consider a sequence $P_1,P_2,\ldots$ of points in the plane such that $P_1,P_2,P_3$ are non-collinear and for every $n\ge4$, $P_n$ is the mid-point of the line segment joining $P_{n-2}$ and $P_{n-3}$. Let $L$ denote the line segment joining $P_1$ and $P_5$. Prove the following: (a) The area of the triangle formed by the points $P_n,P_{n-1},P_{n-2}$ converges to zero as $n$ goes to infinity. (b) The point $P_9$ lies on $L.
